message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you a ballpark figure based on recent averages. Historically, the U.S. dollar has traded around £0.78–0.80 per $1. Using a mid‑point of about £0.78 gives:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;\text{(GBP/USD)} \;\approx\; £15.60
\]

So roughly **£15½** would be the equivalent of $20 today. For an exact amount, you’d want to check a reliable financial source (e.g., your bank, a currency‑conversion website, or a financial news outlet) that provides up‑to‑date rates.
